findings.verification: CYCLE-6: tooling correlation now null-safe with AND logic. Syntax check pass
findings.problem: Tooling correlation: (.success -or ([int].exit_code) -eq 0). [int] casts to 0, so results without exit_code treated as success. OR logic passes broken tools
findings.recommended_fix: Use AND logic with null guard: require success=true AND non-null exit_code=0
findings.impact: Broken or missing tooling results incorrectly treated as passing
findings.implemented_fix: Changed to require success=true AND non-null exit_code=0
findings.evidence: independent-verifier.ps1 line 141: null exit_code cast to 0 = success
findings.root_cause: No null guard on exit_code; OR logic conflates success indicators
